notes.title: Demo Release And Roadmap
notes.notes:
Hey everyone- we’re incredibly excited to launch the standalone demo for Signy And Mino: Against All Gods!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3202580/Signy__Mino_Against_All_Gods_Demo/

If you previously knew us as “Designated Demigod,” we had to undergo a name change. Details here.

Even though we’re a tightly focused single-player adventure, I really wanted to get this game into your hands and get some feedback on early combat feel. We’ve enabled players to leave reviews on the demo page, but you can also reach out directly in our Discord community! I post more frequent updates there and even host the occasional giveaway.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45012640/1159afd5552e2387e069deece67b0ee7535b3c67.png

We’re hard at work on the full game but you can expect to see continued updates to the demo, including things like:

 A redesigned power meter
 An early look at the skill tree
 Inclusion of the world map
 Cleaning up some rough edges on the UI
 Various improvements and bits of polish


Thank you for playing!
